newsitem.title: UK: Hague is bookie's favourite in Conservative race.
newsitem.headline: Hague is bookie's favourite in Conservative race.

text.p: Former Welsh secretary William Hague is 13-8 favourite to win the British Conservative party leadership race following confirmation on Wednesday that he is standing, bookmaker William Hill said.
Hill also offered former social security secretary Peter Lilley at 3-1, former finance minister Kenneth Clarke at 4-1 and former home secretary Michael Howard at 9-2.

Former health secretary Stephen Dorrell was put at 8-1, 1995 leadership challenger John Redwood 10-1 and former education secretary Gillian Shephard, who has already come out as a backer of Lilley, at 33-1. -- London Newsroom +44-171-542-7947
